members.name: percentCPUUsage
members.desc: Percentage of CPU used since the last call to the API that returned this object. First call returns 0.

members.name: cumulativeCPUUsage
members.desc: Total seconds of CPU time used since process startup.

members.name: idleWakeupsPerSecond
members.desc: The number of average idle CPU wakeups per second since the last call to the API that returned this object. First call returns 0. Will always return 0 on Windows.

members.name: mode
members.desc: Controls which processes are profiled. Equivalent to `--memlog` in Chrome. Default is `all`.

members.name: stackMode
members.desc: Controls the type of metadata recorded for each allocation. Equivalent to `--memlog-stack-mode` in Chrome. Default is `native`.

name: MemoryInfo
description: Note that all statistics are reported in Kilobytes.

members.name: workingSetSize
members.desc: The amount of memory currently pinned to actual physical RAM.

members.name: peakWorkingSetSize
members.desc: The maximum amount of memory that has ever been pinned to actual physical RAM.

members.name: privateBytes
members.desc: The amount of memory not shared by other processes, such as JS heap or HTML content.

members.name: residentSet
members.desc: The amount of memory currently pinned to actual physical RAM in Kilobytes.

members.name: private
members.desc: The amount of memory not shared by other processes, such as JS heap or HTML content in Kilobytes.

members.name: shared
members.desc: The amount of memory shared between processes, typically memory consumed by the Electron code itself in Kilobytes.

members.name: pid
members.desc: Process id of the process.

members.name: type
members.desc: Process type. One of the following values:

members.name: serviceName
members.desc: The non-localized name of the process.

members.name: name
members.desc: The name of the process. Examples for utility: `Audio Service`, `Content Decryption Module Service`, `Network Service`, `Video Capture`, etc.

members.name: cpu
members.desc: CPU usage of the process. Its `percentCPUUsage` and `idleWakeupsPerSecond` are averages over the time since the previous call to the API returning this object.

members.name: memory
members.desc: Memory information for the process.

members.name: sandboxed
members.desc: Whether the process is sandboxed on OS level.

members.name: integrityLevel
members.desc: One of the following values:

members.desc: A filter to control what category groups should be traced. A filter can have an optional '-' prefix to exclude category groups that contain a matching category. Having both included and excluded categ

members.name: traceOptions
members.desc: Controls what kind of tracing is enabled, it is a comma-delimited sequence of the following strings: `record-until-full`, `record-continuously`, `trace-to-console`, `enable-sampling`, `enable-systrace

name: TraceConfig
description: An example TraceConfig that roughly matches what Chrome DevTools records:

members.name: recording_mode
members.desc: Can be `record-until-full`, `record-continuously`, `record-as-much-as-possible` or `trace-to-console`. Defaults to `record-until-full`.

members.name: trace_buffer_size_in_kb
members.desc: maximum size of the trace recording buffer in kilobytes. Defaults to 100MB.

members.name: trace_buffer_size_in_events
members.desc: maximum size of the trace recording buffer in events.

members.name: enable_argument_filter
members.desc: if true, filter event data according to a specific list of events that have been manually vetted to not include any PII. See the implementation in Chromium for specifics.

members.name: included_categories
members.desc: a list of tracing categories to include. Can include glob-like patterns using `*` at the end of the category name. See tracing categories for the list of categories.

members.name: excluded_categories
members.desc: a list of tracing categories to exclude. Can include glob-like patterns using `*` at the end of the category name. See tracing categories for the list of categories.

members.name: included_process_ids
members.desc: a list of process IDs to include in the trace. If not specified, trace all processes.

members.name: histogram_names
members.desc: a list of histogram names to report with the trace.

members.name: memory_dump_config
members.desc: if the `disabled-by-default-memory-infra` category is enabled, this contains optional additional configuration for data collection. See the Chromium memory-infra docs for more information.
